test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the correct sequence to form a meaningful sentence:

(A) has a long

(B) India

(C) and rich

(D) cultural history
solution:
The correct answer is **Option (3)** i.e. **BACD**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence begins with the subject "India," which is correctly indicated by **part (B).**
 
• Following the subject, "has a long" **(BA)** continues the logical sequence, indicating India's possession of something.
 
• The next part, "and rich" **(AC)** adds more context to what India has, and it further qualifies the possession.
 
• Ending with "cultural history" **(CD)** completes the sentence by specifying what is being described.

Therefore, the correct answer is **BACD.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (BDCA):** This option places "cultural history" before "and rich," which disrupts the logical flow of the sentence.
 
• **Option 2 (BCAD):** This option places "and rich" after "cultural history," making the sentence grammatically incorrect.
 
• **Option 4 (BADC):** This option places "has a long" after "and rich," which makes the structure awkward and illogical.
